simple.meaning: אַלּוּף (ʼallûwph) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “familiar ; a friend , also gentle ; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow ); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H441. alluwph I. אַלּוּף adjective tame — ׳א absolute Micah 7:5 +; construct Prov 2:17 +; suffix אַלּוּפֵי Psa 55:14 ; plural אַלֻּפִים Jer 13:21 ; suffix אַלֻּפֵינוּ Psa 144:14 , etc.; — 1 tame, docile , אַלּוּף כֶּבֶשׂ a docile (gentle) lamb Jer 11:19 . 2. noun masculine friend, intimate Psa 55:14 (|| מְיֻדָּע ) Micah 7:5 (|| רֵעַ ) Prov 16:28 ; 17:9 ; Jer 13:21 ; of a woman's husband ׳א נְעוּרֶיהָ Prov 2:17 ; figurative of ׳י as husband of Judah, id. , Jer 3:4 . 3 i. q. I. אֶלֶף ; מְסֻבָּלִים אַלּוּפֵינוּ Psa 144:14 (i.e. cows). II. אַלּוּף noun masculine 1Chr 1:51 chief, chiliarch (denominative from II. אֶלֶף see Di Gen 36:15 ) — ׳א absolute 36:15 +; plural construct אַלּוּפֵי ( אַלֻּפֵי ) Exod 15:15 +; suffix אַלּוּפֵיהֶם Gen 36:19 , 30 — chief (tribal) of Edom 36:15 (5 t.) + 38 t.
